results.title: Manager, Micro Mobility Operations
results.description: Redefining Land, Air, and Sea Travel… Elevating Destinations. Coastal Transportation Services Co., a Red Sea Global Subsidiary Coastal Transportation Services Company, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, provides Transportation services at our Red Sea destination and is part of the Red Sea Global Group of companies. We specialize in providing transportation services to our Red Sea destination. As a subsidiary, Coastal Transportation Services Co. benefits from shared strategic goals and collaborative initiatives within the Red Sea Global group of companies, enhancing our ability to serve our clients effectively. Are you ready to transform the future of transportation? At Coastal Transportation Services Co., we are driven by innovation, creativity, and a passion for redefining transportation. Our team is shaping the future with cutting-edge projects, from autonomous vehicles to sustainable transportation solutions. We are seeking forward-thinking individuals eager to collaborate in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where ideas become reality. Join us in revolutionizing transportation and creating a smarter, more sustainable world—one innovation at a time. Join our visionary team and help shape the future of transportation! Job Purpose: To lead the operational planning, coordination, and continuous improvement of micro mobility services across the organization’s properties. This role is responsible for ensuring seamless delivery of buggy, e-bike, and other micro mobility solutions, supporting the wider Mobility strategy. The position holds accountability for service delivery, stakeholder engagement, team leadership and operational efficiency in a 24/7 environment. Key Responsibilities: Service Operations Leadership Manage daily micro mobility operations across multiple service types and locations. Ensure service continuity, timely asset availability and operational resilience. Support integration of new modes (e.g., e-bikes, scooters) as part of service expansion. Team and Resource Management Lead supervisory staff, operators, and support teams across the micro mobility network. Set clear expectations and performance standards aligned with safety and customer service. Oversee training, onboarding, and staff scheduling to meet service requirements. Performance and Compliance Oversight Ensure all services operate within regulatory, safety and policy frameworks. Monitor service metrics and deliver improvement plans to enhance efficiency and user satisfaction. Implement incident management protocols and ensure timely resolution of issues. Stakeholder Engagement Act as key point of contact for operational queries, escalations, and service coordination. Work cross-functionally with departments including Land Operations, TOCC, Maintenance and Projects. Liaise with vendors and partners to support service delivery and infrastructure readiness. Planning and Development Support service expansion through structured operational plans and asset deployment strategies. Drive forward innovation and technology adoption within micro mobility operations. Assist in the development of SOPs, risk assessments and operational documentation. Reporting and Communication Provide regular operational updates, service performance reports and improvement proposals. Ensure consistent communication across teams and with leadership. Profile Requirements Experience in operations or transport leadership, preferably within micro mobility or fleet services. Proven ability to manage teams in fast-paced, high-visibility environments. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across functions and resolve challenges quickly. Operational mindset with the ability to lead services at both strategic and frontline levels. Adaptable and resourceful, with a commitment to service excellence.

results.title: Senior Director: Mobility Planner
results.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description **Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia** Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey. The Senior Director: Mobility Planner is the ultimate technical, operational, and strategic authority responsible for the end-to-end planning, efficiency, and day-to-day management of the city’s multi-modal mobility network. With a mandate requiring extensive distinguished leadership experience, this executive-level leader oversees the live operations of the entire transportation ecosystem. This includes public transit systems, autonomous shuttle corridors, active mobility trails, parking networks, micro-mobility, and intelligent traffic management systems. Sitting firmly within the O&M division, this role focuses on maximizing network throughput, minimizing congestion, deploying next-generation smart-city mobility technologies, and ensuring safe, seamless, and sustainable journeys for millions of annual residents and visitors. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Network & Transit Operations (O&M) Direct the daily operations, transit scheduling, and fleet management of all public and private transportation systems, including buses, light rail/monorail, micro-mobility, and autonomous mass transit networks. Oversee the strategic implementation of active mobility frameworks, managing pedestrian corridors, bike networks, and scooter-sharing infrastructure to ensure perfect connectivity between major city hubs and entertainment districts. Serve as the principal authority for high-footfall event transport planning, designing mega-crowd traffic diversion models, park-and-ride strategies, and flexible transit surges to handle peak visitor loads seamlessly. Formulate robust emergency transportation plans, network redundancy routes, and incident-response protocols to guarantee zero-disruption mobility during grid failures or civil emergencies. Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) & Traffic Engineering Direct the operational deployment and tuning of the city's Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), including adaptive traffic signals, automated speed enforcement, and real-time transit information displays. Partner with the digital city operations hub to leverage real-time traffic flow telemetry, predictive AI congestion mapping, and IoT sensor loops to optimize vehicle movements city-wide. Act as the technical authority for the city's smart car parks, integrating automated parking guidance systems (PGS), automated billing, license plate recognition (LPR), and electric vehicle (EV) charging grids with the broader mobility network. Financial Cost Recovery & Asset Integration Translate multi-modal usage logs, public transit ticketing data, and shared mobility fees into automated financial models for corporate finance teams. Provide the Service Charge Director with audited transit-wear metrics to ensure equitable infrastructure cross-charging, charging commercial zones, theme parks, and venues their fair share for the mobility infrastructure feeding their districts. Collaborate with the Asset Lifecycle Planning (LCP) division to map out multi-decade Capital Asset Replacement Plans (CARP) for core mobility infrastructure (e.g., transit fleets, smart charging arrays, signals, and ITS servers). Partner with the SAP-EAMS team to ensure every vehicle, charging dock, traffic sensor, and transit station is assigned a flawless digital ID for data-driven, predictive maintenance scheduling. Stage-Gate Handover & Design Advisory Serve as the primary mobility gatekeeper on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee, auditing traffic impact assessments (TIAs) and multi-modal readiness before newly constructed transit corridors or roads transition into live city operations. Formulate rigorous testing and commissioning verification rules for all transit fleets and smart ITS software networks prior to full operational adoption from builders and vendors. Job Requirements & Qualifications Education & Professional Credentials Bachelor’s Degree in Transportation Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Design, Traffic Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical discipline from an accredited institution. Master’s Degree in Transportation Engineering, Smart Mobility, Urban Planning, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred. Professional Certifications: Active senior professional registration, such as a Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or certification from the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) / Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE). Experience 25+ years of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in multi-modal urban transit planning, large-scale traffic engineering, or smart city mobility operations. At least 8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity, directly managing multi-disciplinary transport teams and multi-million-dollar mobility operational and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX). Proven track record of spearheading the operational setup, network routing, or post-construction integration of giga-scale mass transit networks, autonomous vehicle testbeds, or smart-city traffic frameworks. Deep experience navigating micro-mobility logistics, fleet electrification challenges, demand-side traffic management, and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability and smart city targets. Technical & Soft Skills Deep technical command over macro and micro traffic simulation modeling software (e.g., PTV VISSIM, VISUM, Synchro, or equivalent platforms). Executive-level fluency in transport operational technologies, including fleet telematics, automated fare collection (AFC) engines, and SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAMS) integrations. One customer experience that we're constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver orders. Our goal is to exceed the expectations of all our customers. To meet this goal, Amazon is continually striving to innovate and provide best-in-class service levels through the introduction of pioneering new products and services in the last mile delivery space. The MEATR (Middle East, Africa, and Turkey) Fleet organization is responsible for managing and growing Amazon's Last Mile Fleet across the region. We are seeking an exceptional Senior Manager to lead Fleet Strategy, Planning and Programs for the MEATR (Africa, Middle East, and Turkey) region—one of our fastest-growing and most dynamic markets. In this pivotal role, you will be the strategic architect of MEATRs fleet operations, responsible for the complete fleet lifecycle from demand forecasting and procurement to operational excellence and partner experience. You'll leverage sophisticated analytical modeling to predict fleet requirements years in advance, drive operational excellence through data-driven insights, and ensure our Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) have the tools and support they need to succeed. This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of Amazon's logistics capabilities in a high-growth region. results.title: Transportation Supervisor
results.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Transport Supervisor to oversee and coordinate daily transportation operations between the Distribution Center (DC) and assigned dark store locations across Kuwait . The role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and efficient movement of goods from the DC to dark stores, managing delivery routes and schedules, overseeing truck fleet operations and utilization , monitoring driver performance, and maintaining high standards of operational efficiency and service quality. The Transport Supervisor will also be responsible for route planning and optimization, delivery allocation, truck fleet management, vehicle utilization and availability, driver coordination, transportation performance tracking, and managing operational issues and delays . The role will work closely with DC and dark store teams to ensure smooth and reliable replenishment operations, minimize delivery delays, optimize transportation resources, and ensure that dark stores receive the required inventory on time. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation operations from the Distribution Center (DC) to assigned dark store locations , ensuring timely, safe, and efficient movement of goods and smooth execution of replenishment plans. Plan, coordinate, and optimize transport routes, delivery schedules, truck allocation, and delivery capacity based on business requirements, store demand, and operational priorities. Manage and monitor the truck fleet , including vehicle availability, utilization, deployment, maintenance coordination, and overall fleet efficiency. Coordinate and supervise drivers and transport teams , ensuring adherence to delivery schedules, assigned routes, operational procedures, safety requirements, and service standards. Monitor daily transportation performance and key KPIs, including on-time delivery, route efficiency, vehicle utilization, delivery turnaround time, transportation costs, and service quality . Track deliveries in real time, identify delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and other transportation exceptions, and take timely corrective actions to minimize operational disruptions. Coordinate closely with DC, dark store, warehouse, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate loading, dispatch, receiving, and timely replenishment of dark stores. Identify, investigate, and resolve transportation-related operational issues and delivery exceptions, conducting root-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Analyze transportation data and operational trends to identify opportunities for route optimization, fleet utilization, cost reduction, and process improvement . Ensure compliance with company transportation policies, fleet safety standards, vehicle requirements, driver procedures, and applicable local regulations . Oversee the training and development of drivers and transport team members, ensuring they have the required operational knowledge, safety awareness, and service standards. Prepare regular transportation performance reports and provide data-driven insights and recommendations to management on fleet performance, route efficiency, operational issues, and improvement opportunities. Support the development and continuous optimization of transportation processes, route planning, fleet management, and DC-to-dark-store delivery operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and overall service quality. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration , or a related field; alternatively, 3+ years of relevant experience in transport, logistics, or delivery operations . Proven experience in delivery, transport, logistics, fleet, preferably within a fast-paced e-commerce or delivery environment. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and identify performance improvement opportunities. Strong execution and follow-up skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good project management and process improvement capabilities. Fluent in English , with strong written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to be based in Kuwait and work according to operational requirements, including flexible working hours when necessary.

results.title: Logistics & Fleet Analyst
results.description: Job Summary We are looking for a Logistics & Fleet Analyst to support our day-to-day transportation, fleet, driver, Sales invoices, and logistics operations. The role will be responsible for monitoring fleet performance, coordinating trucks and drivers, analyzing logistics costs, Sales invoices , maintaining accurate records, and supporting efficient delivery operations. Key Responsibilities Coordinate daily Sales Invoices / truck and driver allocation based on delivery requirements. Monitor truck utilization, delivery schedules, routes, and vehicle availability. Coordinate with Warehouse, Sales, and Logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries. Monitor driver attendance, trips, working hours, and performance. Maintain accurate fleet, driver, vehicle, and delivery records. Track fuel consumption, maintenance, repair costs, and other fleet-related expenses. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly fleet and logistics performance reports. Analyze transportation costs and identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvement. Monitor delivery performance, including delays, trip completion, and POD status. Support the preparation and processing of sales invoices and delivery-related documents, where required. Work closely with external transporters and service providers when required. Develop and maintain Excel-based trackers and dashboards for fleet and logistics KPIs. Support management with logistics data analysis, forecasting, and operational reports. Ensure compliance with company policies, safety requirements, and local transportation regulations. Qualifications & Requirements Minimum 3 years relevant experience in Kuwait / GCC Logistics, Fleet Management, Transportation Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, and data analysis. Experience with ERP, WMS, TMS, fleet management systems, or other logistics software. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to prepare and interpret logistics and fleet performance reports.. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple operational priorities. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage.

results.title: Fleet Lead.E - Commerce - Fulfillment Operations
results.description: Job Description Job Purpose The Fleet Lead is responsible for overseeing and managing the company's delivery fleet to ensure the efficient and timely transportation of goods. This role focuses on ensuring that the fleet operates safely, cost-effectively, and in compliance with all legal and company requirements. The Fleet Lead also monitors the performance of drivers, manages vehicle maintenance schedules, and implements strategies to optimize fleet operations. Key Accountabilities Fleet Management: Oversee the day-to-day operations of the fleet, including vehicle allocation, scheduling, and tracking to ensure timely deliveries. Driver Supervision: Lead and supervise a team of drivers, ensuring they follow company policies, safety standards, and performance expectations. Vehicle Maintenance: Coordinate regular maintenance and repairs of the fleet to ensure vehicles are roadworthy and safe, minimizing downtime and operational disruptions. Fleet Performance Monitoring: Track fleet performance metrics such as fuel efficiency, delivery times, and maintenance costs, and take action to improve fleet performance and reduce costs. Safety & Compliance: Ensure that all fleet operations comply with legal regulations, safety protocols, and company policies. Conduct regular safety checks and driver training. Route Optimization: Collaborate with the logistics team to optimize delivery routes, reduce fuel consumption, and increase efficiency in delivery times. Budget & Cost Control: Manage the fleet budget, ensuring cost-effective operations while maintaining high service standards. Identify areas for cost savings and operational improvements. Vendor & Supplier Relations: Manage relationships with external vendors, including vehicle leasing companies, fuel suppliers, and maintenance service providers to ensure high-quality service and competitive pricing. Reporting & Documentation: Maintain accurate records of vehicle inspections, repairs, fuel usage, and driver performance. Prepare reports on fleet performance for management review. Team Training & Development: Provide ongoing training and development for drivers to ensure they are equipped with the knowledge and skills needed to perform their roles effectively. Skills Description Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent; a Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field is preferred Experience Minimum of 5 years of experience in fleet management or logistics, with at least 2 years in a leadership role overseeing drivers and vehicles Key Competencies Strong leadership and organizational skills. Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Knowledge of vehicle maintenance and fleet management best practices. Ability to manage budgets and control costs. Familiarity with fleet management software and tracking tools

results.title: Manager Logistics Performance
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Role Summary This role owns the commercial and performance engine behind talabat UAE's operations. You'll be the person who understands how the business actually ticks, where margin is made or lost, which levers move the numbers, and what trade-offs leadership is really weighing. You'll own the operational commercials and KPI performance, drive the optimization work that improves efficiency and experience, and turn analysis into decisions. It's a role for someone equally comfortable in a model and in a room full of directors, someone who can read the data and stand their ground on what it means . What's on your plate? Commercial & P&L Ownership for Operations Own the commercials behind UAE operations, cost-per-order, rider cost, and the efficiency metrics that drive the operational P&L. Track budget vs. actuals, protect riders and 3pls earnings, and give leadership clear, data-backed trade-offs between cost, growth, and customer experience. You're the person who can explain why the numbers moved, not just that they did. Performance Management Own the UAE operational KPI stack, from forecast to actuals. Anticipate performance gaps before they hit the P&L and drive the interventions that close them. Run the reporting and executive reviews that keep leadership decision-ready. Operational Optimization Drive the optimization agenda across the network: rider economics and staffing efficiency, vendor and coverage performance, area-level improvements. Find where the operation leaks cost or time, size the opportunity, and lead the fix, balancing efficiency against rider earnings and customer experience. Data, Modeling & Insight Be genuinely good with data, able to interrogate complex models, understand what's driving them, and pressure-test assumptions rather than take outputs at face value. Build the analyses and dashboards that make decisions faster, and translate complexity into a clear "so what." SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau are a strong plus; the non-negotiable is analytical judgment. Strategic Projects & Senior Stakeholder Leadership Lead cross-functional, high-impact projects that shape UAE operations. Build the business case, run the pilot, scale what works. Throughout, work directly with senior leadership, and hold your own with directors and VPs, defending a recommendation with evidence and staying credible under challenge. What you own vs. influence: You own the operational commercials, the performance KPI stack, and the delivery of your optimization projects. You influence the ops, commercial, and product teams whose execution moves those numbers, through insight, credibility, and stakeholder trust rather than direct authority. Qualifications What did we order? At least 4 years in operations, commercial, strategy, or consulting, ideally in a marketplace, logistics, or Q-commerce environment. Commercial instinct: you understand how a business makes money and which levers actually move it. Strong data literacy, comfortable working with complex data and models, interrogating assumptions, and drawing the right conclusion. You don't need to be handed the answer. Executive presence: able to engage, challenge, and stand your ground with senior stakeholders including directors and VPs. Financial modeling and P&L fluency, you can read a model, break it, and explain it. SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau a strong plus, not a requirement. Bias for ownership and follow-through, you close the loop rather than hand off the problem. Readiness to grow into people leadership (1–2 reports over time).

results.title: Logistics Manager
results.description: Manager - Logistics We are seeking an experienced Manager - Logistics to lead and optimise end-to-end logistics operations within a large-scale industrial or manufacturing environment. This role is responsible for overseeing transportation, warehousing, inventory movement, distribution, and third-party logistics providers while ensuring operational efficiency, cost optimisation, and high service levels. Key Responsibilities Manage inbound and outbound logistics operations across multiple transportation modes. Oversee warehousing, inventory control, and material handling activities. Develop and implement logistics strategies to improve efficiency and reduce costs. Manage relationships with logistics service providers, carriers, and transportation partners. Monitor logistics performance through KPIs and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure timely delivery of materials and finished goods while maintaining customer satisfaction. Ensure compliance with applicable safety, regulatory, and environmental standards. Lead, mentor, and develop logistics teams to achieve operational excellence. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field. 5-7+ years of experience in logistics or supply chain management, preferably within manufacturing, industrial, metals, or heavy industry sectors. Strong knowledge of transportation, warehousing, inventory management, and distribution operations. Proven experience managing third-party logistics providers and carrier networks. Demonstrated leadership, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a focus on cost optimization. Professional certifications such as CSCP, CLTD, or equivalent are an advantage. Let op: vacaturefraude Helaas komt vacaturefraude steeds vaker voor. results.title: ZAIN2433 - Inventory & Logistics Team Leader/Manager
results.description: About The Role The Inventory & Logistics Manager is responsible for leading inventory and logistics operations to ensure efficient stock management, timely shipment clearance, product availability, and seamless distribution across all sales channels. The role oversees inventory planning, logistics processes, warehouse operations, and supplier coordination while ensuring operational excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Lead inventory and logistics operations to ensure timely delivery and fulfilment of business requirements. Oversee shipment clearance, customs processes, and supplier deliveries until inventory is received and distributed. Manage inventory planning, stock replenishment, and buffer stock levels to maintain product availability. Oversee SIM cards, recharge cards, devices, and commercial/non-commercial inventory lifecycle management. Ensure effective warehouse operations, stock classification, item coding, and inventory accuracy. Manage return-to-vendor (RTV) activities, logistics coordination, and supplier returns. Monitor inventory KPIs and implement actions to improve operational efficiency and inventory performance. Collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Sales, Warehouse, IT, and Logistics teams to support business objectives. Identify process improvement opportunities and lead inventory and logistics optimization initiatives. Ensure compliance with company policies, governance standards, ISMS requirements, and health & safety regulations. What We Need From You Skills Strong leadership and people management skills. Solid knowledge of inventory management, logistics, warehousing, and supply chain operations. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in inventory planning, forecasting, and stock optimization. Knowledge of procurement and supply chain best practices. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Advanced Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills. Experience with ERP and inventory management systems. Strong project management and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Education Level/ Major Bachelor’s Degree required Business or a related field; Master’s in business/MBA preferred Years Of Experience +7 About Application Process If you meet the criteria and you are enthusiastic about the role, we would welcome your application. To complete the application you would need the following document(s): Resume/CV Passport-size photograph Highest Education Qualification Copy of Civil ID/Passport Kuwait Nationality Certificate-Sahel

results.title: Sr. Analyst Logistics Performance
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Role Summary: Managing the logistics performance of the country to maintain operational excellence and influence business decisions, by monitoring operational KPIs and by developing analytical reports and dashboards. Improve operational efficiency by identifying future trends based on past performance. Work closely with local and regional stakeholders to define, design and develop analytic solutions to improve optimization and mitigate risks. What’s On Your Plate? Reporting and monitoring of KPIs and performance SLAs to maintain operational excellence. Analysing and deriving insights from large, complex sets of data. Identify and solve logistics performance related problems utilizing these insights. Proactively suggest areas for improvements to deliver optimal performance to logistics and other functions in the business. Use data, statistical models and research to detect trends and make predictions of the future based on insights gained Create and enhance data visualization and analytical tools to support business goals. Manage the implementation of Performance Management projects including post implementation support. Qualifications What Did We Order? Bachelor's Degree, preferably in Information Systems or STEM Proficiency with SQL is preferred +5 years’ experience, analytical roles in tech start-ups and/or in pricing highly preferred Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal) Very strong analytical skills and problem-solving with complex data sets Strong research, presentation, and analytical skills Strong business acumen, and statistics knowledge. Highly computer literacy with proficiency in the use of Google suite or MOffice (Sheets/Excel & Slides/ PowerPoint) An individual contributor who can work in a fast-paced environment with a make it happen attitude.
